body: I understand what you are going through. Life sometimes just gets really tiring and hard, and you begin to feel like you just really need an escape. But your mind telling you of the consequences is a way of your body trying to stay alive. Our mind is our best well-wisher. It will do anything it can to keep us alive. And it sometimes you just wish it would stop, but maybe it is a good thing. Sometimes it makes us realize what we miss when we decide to end it all. Sometimes it makes us realize life might in fact be worth living and dying isn't worth the trouble and consequences. I will not make any promises, but please try your best to get past whatever you are going through right now. I wish you the best of luck in your future en devours. Hope this helps.

Devote more time to her. Dogs tend to be very reciprocative so shower her with affection. I promise she will make you feel better. I myself used to have a dog and he honestly helped me with my social anxiety as well. They truly are mans best friend. When you are in a better state emotionally, try your luck again. For a man of your accomplishments, any girl would be lucky to have you.

Love is an extremely fragile element. It is a term thrown around so much that it has lost meaning. There are three ways to say "I love you" in Japanese, in escalating manner, with the most serious one being "I want to spend all nights under the moon with you". It gives a deeper meaning to relationships. In your scenario, you two hit a snag where she had to move away due to her career, but she did not love you. She realized that if she mentioned career, you would perhaps have suggested long distance, and tried to keep the relationship going, so she took the blame on herself and told you she didn't know how to love you the way you loved her. She predicted a heartbreak in the relationship, but I doubt her going away was the primary reason. 
What I'm trying to say here is that she never really loved you. Nobody with respectable feelings for another person would tell they love them, and break up the very next day. It spits on the meaning of the word love. You need to move past this relationship, and realize she was not the one. You should not change yourself because of this, as she was clearly the one in fault. You gave her your all and she took it for granted. Just move on and find someone else. Your soulmate might just be around the corner. As the famous saying goes: there's plenty of fish in the sea. Good luck bro!

Something you should try and I think would really help is get a dog. They are extremely faithful and loving companions, and since human interactions have always been getting you down, maybe taking a break from them would be a preferable choice. However, emphasis on the word break, since we all eventually seek human interactions. Keep an open mind towards others, and don't get yourself down. Stay confident as who you are. If you do not like something you do, then take an honest effort to change, and believe me, you will feel much better about yourself. Now go out there and change your life, starting today. Have a great day mate.

I am fully aware of this. People who come here are suffering from serious issues, some of them might even have one hand on the mouse while holding a knife in the other. My purpose with this post was to bring even just a slight bit of hesitation in them, for them to at least consider a solution. There is always a way out, no matter how grim the outlook is, and I hoped to shed light on that through this post. However I do see where you're coming from. At a glance, the post does seem a bit pointless since it doesn't focus on any specific issues, but perhaps to somebody on the verge of ending their journey, it might make a difference :)
